title: feat(security): add the read-only viewAllFields object-permission bit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGwXUPGyf4u6SgkkjygnbHK)_

Fixes #36050

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36053

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：权限集可以多写一个"可查看全部字段"的只读开关，平台管理员和组织管理员权限集都已带上它，但今天任何人能看到、能改的字段都和以前一样。
- 属于"记录范围与字段权限分开"这项安全改造的第一步，为以后"查看全部记录不再自动放开字段"的大版本切换先铺好开关。
- 出错时最坏情况是某个角色多看到或少看到一些字段；本次不改变现有行为，撤回这一个合并即可恢复。
- 无

## What changes

The read-only `viewAllFields` object-permission bit (step 2 of the field-axis split, decision card ruling of record 6912661484, letter A): a read vote on every field of the object, fields added later included, never an edit vote, and inside one set the set's own field row beats it.

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`): `viewAllFields: z.boolean().optional()` on `ObjectPermissionSchema` (so also on the wire `EffectiveObjectPermissionSchema`), no default so no parsed entry materializes it. Liveness ledger row `live`. Generated: authorable surface, reference docs, liveness counts.
- **The one shared vote** (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`): `superuserFieldVote` now also casts the read vote for a set that carries `viewAllFields` on the object (own entry, else its `'*'`, the same lookup as `holdsSuperuserBypass`), skipped where that set's own row says `readable: false`; never an edit vote. `holdsSuperuserBypass` is NOT widened, so the row-level bypass, the private-posture wildcard rule and the admin posture do not read the bit. Both merges (`PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions`, `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions`) already call this one function.
- **Built-in admin sets**: `admin_full_access` carries `viewAllFields: true` on its wildcard through the one platform-admin declaration, `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` (`packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts`); the PLATFORM_ADMIN posture still derives from the two record bits only. `organization_admin` carries it on its wildcard (`default-permission-sets.ts`). `deriveWallLessOrgAdmin` drops it together with the two record bits: the no-bypass variant never held that field vote, so keeping it would be a behaviour change.
- **Super-user-bit readers**, each judged below.
- **Access matrix**: optional `viewAllFields` column on `AccessMatrixEntrySchema`, written only when `true`; the semantic diff names it ("gains View All Fields on ..."), and compares bits as booleans so an absent column reads as `false`.

### Super-user-bit enumerators (grep of `viewAllRecords` across `packages/`, non-test sources)

Changed (they enumerate the bits for a field-visibility or privilege judgement):

- `core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` `superuserFieldVote`: casts the read vote (new private `holdsViewAllFields`).
- `plugin-security/src/agent-ceiling-clamp.ts` `AGENT_CEILING_OBJECT_KEYS`: clears it; left standing it would keep the field half of View All under the agent ceiling.
- `plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` `organizationBoundaryFailure` condition (a): a `'*'` entry carrying it is outside the organization boundary (own wording: "the read-every-field bit").
- `spec/src/security/high-privilege.ts` `describeHighPrivilegeBits`: "View All Fields on ..." is high-privilege, so not bound to `everyone` / `guest`.
- `lint/src/build-access-matrix.ts` + `spec/src/security/explain.zod.ts` `AccessMatrixEntrySchema`: the column and its diff label.
- `plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`: `organization_admin` wildcard (~400) and the no-wall split (~1768); `spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts` `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` wildcard (the `admin_full_access` content).

Judged record-scope / object-access only (unchanged, `viewAllFields` must not enter them):

- `plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts` `resolveObjectPermission` (private-posture wildcard), `superuserBypassSets` / `hasSuperuserRead|WriteBypass`, `getEffectiveScope` / `getDeclaredScope` (read/write depth).
- `core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` `holdsSuperuserBypass`, `wildcardGrantsSuperRead`, `foldWildcardSuperUser`, `seedSuperUserRestrictedObjects`, `foldSuperUserWildcardGrants`, `materializePlainWildcardCoverage`, `lowerModifyAllRecords` (object map, not field map).
- `core/src/security/posture-ladder.ts`, `resolve-authz-context.ts`, `tenant-layer0-verdict.ts` (ADR-0095 D3 posture; comments only).
- `lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts` `grantFor` (~222, private-posture lookup; comment added) and `fieldHidden` (own row binds; the bit never lifts it, doc added).
- `lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` `holdsSuperuserBypass` copy (`modify` only), `grantsObjectAccess`, the wildcard-VAMA rule, the field-mask-inert rule (Modify All only), `validate-nav-access.ts`, `validate-synced-private-readability.ts`.
- `plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts` (the `vama_bypass` row layer; its `fls` layer reads `getFieldPermissions`, so it sees the bit; channel naming is #36051), `security-plugin*.ts`, `managed-object-write-denies.ts`, `auto-org-admin-grant.ts` (picks a set name, builds no wildcard).
- `objectql/src/engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts`, `verify/src/parent-write-reach.ts`, `spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` scope/write-implies-read refinements, `qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts` (reads `superuserFieldVote(...).editable`, which the bit never sets).

## Tests

- `plugin-security/src/fls-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts` (new top-level describes on the shared FLS harness, both merges each): the bit alone opens, read-only, every field another set hides (object entry and wildcard); no edit vote; an explicit `editable: true` row still edits; own `readable: false` row beats own bit; an explicit object entry is the set's whole answer; the two merges agree; the bit is no row-level bypass. **No-behaviour-change pin**: the shipped `organization_admin` and the shipped `admin_full_access`, each against the same set with the bit stripped, alone and beside the app mask, a View All set, and a View All set with its own `readable: false` row, on both merges and on `sys_user`: identical maps. Control: adding the bit to the no-bypass variant DOES change the map, which is why the derivation drops it.
- `core/src/security/superuser-field-vote-33828.test.ts`: the same rules on `superuserFieldVote` / `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions`, and beside View All / Modify All the bit changes nothing.
- `default-permission-sets.test.ts`: the pre-move literal of `admin_full_access` records `viewAllFields` as an on-purpose addition (docblock note). `spec/src/identity/platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts`: the declaration's wildcard carries the bit and parses with it.
- `agent-ceiling-clamp.test.ts`: the key list, and the clamped set casts no field vote. `delegated-admin-gate-catalog.test.ts`: condition (a) names the bit; per-object bit and plain wildcard stay inside. `high-privilege.test.ts`, `permission.test.ts` (parses, optional with no default, grants no verb, wire shape), `build-access-matrix.test.ts` (column only when true, explicit `false` byte-identical, gains/loses lines).

## Acceptance notes

**For the contract review:** `viewAllFields` on a `'*'` entry votes on the fields of private-posture objects too. The field vote resolves the set's own entry, else its `'*'`, exactly as `holdsSuperuserBypass` does, and that lookup ignores the private posture. The bit stays a field vote only: it grants no object access, so on a private object it matters only where another set grants the object, and `resolveObjectPermission`'s private-posture wildcard rule is untouched. The seat kept this reading (option A) and asks L2 to rule on it.


- `/auth/me/permissions` for an `admin_full_access` or `organization_admin` holder now echoes `viewAllFields: true` on its `objects['*']` entry, like the record bits it already echoes there (the object merge copies authored keys). No per-object entry gains it.
- `security-wildcard-vama` (package-authored `'*'` super-user) does not flag a `'*'` carrying only `viewAllFields`; adding it would be a new lint refusal, left to the lint cards of the parent.
- `examples/app-crm/access-matrix.json`: rebuilt from the stack with this branch's `buildAccessMatrix`, byte-identical (control: authoring the bit on `crm_sales_user/crm_account` makes it differ). `app-showcase` not measured: its config imports a connector with no `dist` in this checkout.

## Verification

Read first: (1) `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`, the `superuserFieldVote` hunk and `holdsViewAllFields`; (2) `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`, the `deriveWallLessOrgAdmin` destructuring; (3) `packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts`, the platform-admin wildcard.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/fls-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts` shows 62 passed, including the no-behaviour-change pins on the shipped admin sets.

Local readings on the final head are in the issue's report comment.
